source_citation: Diggs, Lipscomb & O'Kennon (1999), Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas
source_name: Acacia greggii A. Gray var. greggii
taxonomic_crosswalk_note: Flora explicitly distinguishes var. greggii from var. wrightii; Kew POWO places A. greggii under Senegalia greggii and treats var. wrightii as Senegalia wrightii

morphology_source_reported.habit: Spiny shrub or small tree, usually (1–)2–3 m tall [species account]
morphology_source_reported.leaves: 1–3 pairs of pinnae per leaf [species]; leaflets 3–6 mm long [varietal key]
morphology_source_reported.flowers: Sweet scented; creamy-white filaments; elongate inflorescences 2–5 cm long [varietal key]
morphology_source_reported.fruits: 5–8 cm long, 15–20 mm wide [species]; typically strongly constricted and often twisted [varietal key]

cautions: Do not infer Hays County nativity from Flora regional statements
